verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls (such as secure drive erase, storage encryption, or GPU memory scrubbing) are a fair question for an on-prem AI system like the DGX B200, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any retention or deletion capability. The material covers performance, health monitoring, power redundancy, BMC management, and community notes on NVLink multi-tenant isolation, none of which address data retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
